laws.name: Delaware Paid Family and Medical Leave (Healthy Delaware Families Act)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and safe leave for issues related to domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking. Applies to most employers with 10 or more employees.

laws.name: Delaware State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Delaware state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Delaware State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Delaware state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
